The 991 generation was launched at the end of 2011 and continued until 2019.
The services of the 991 are carried out every 2 years or 20.000 kms. but an annual oil change service or 10.000 kms is recommended.
The 991 was renewed in 2016, where one of the biggest changes was the replacement of the engine from the naturally aspirated 3.8 to a 3.0 biturbo.

Although servicing of the 991 is recommended every 2 years or 20.000 kms, it is worth being preventive, as this is a time interval and mileage quite long for engine oil. We recommend an annual oil change to ensure the oil remains in the best possible condition.
Annual 991 services also benefit from an extensive checklist, as a technician will inspect the vehicle to ensure it is in top condition.

While these are the basic minimum requirements for performing servicing on the 992, we often find that owners like to perform an intermediate oil change. This not only allows the vehicle to be inspected for safety by a professional every 12 months, but also ensures that the oil is kept in the best possible condition, further improving engine reliability.
Our qualified technicians have experience not only in the servicing of the 992, but also in advising on any car modification you wish to make, upgrading or customization with our partner TECHART.

At Valentin the diagnosis is the key.
